safety.negligible: No physical actuation, kinetic energy, thermal, or life-safety pathway (pure digital/informational).
safety.low: Minor physical inconvenience or non-hazardous comfort setting change (e.g., HVAC/infotainment preference) with hardware interlock intact.
safety.medium: Single-device/vehicle non-lethal operational hazard or immobilizer/charging interruption while stationary (ISO 26262 S1 / IEC 62443 SL-2).
safety.high: Single vehicle/charger/robot hazardous actuation or loss of safety monitoring without immediate multi-unit propagation (ISO 26262 S2 / ASIL-B).
safety.critical: Fleet-wide, BESS/grid, factory OT, or kinetic actuation capable of severe injury, thermal runaway, or loss of life (ISO 26262 S3 / ASIL-C/D, Gate 0 Emergency Brake).
safety.catastrophic: Alias for critical: irreversible multi-vehicle/BESS/plant safety hazard or human life threat requiring immediate Gate 0 Emergency Brake.

financial.negligible: No direct monetary loss, billing manipulation, or settlement discrepancy (< $100 equivalent).
financial.low: Isolated single-transaction coupon/fee rounding or minor credit abuse (< $1,000, manually reversible).
financial.medium: Repeatable single-account billing/charging/voucher fraud or B2B reconciliation drift ($1,000 - $50,000).
financial.high: Automated multi-account wallet/refund/charging subsidy drain, paid OTA bypass, or partner settlement manipulation ($50,000 - $500,000).
financial.critical: Unbounded treasury/wallet drain, mass fleet billing fraud, or ERP/SAP financial ledger corruption (> $500,000).
financial.catastrophic: Alias for critical: systemic financial or ERP ledger compromise (> $500,000).

operational.negligible: No measurable service degradation or operational disruption.
operational.low: Single non-critical component degradation or cosmetic workflow error affecting < 1% of users.
operational.medium: Single service or regional feature outage, background worker stall, or support queue spike with manual workaround.
operational.high: Multi-tenant/domain outage (dealer portal, charging CSMS, or CI/CD pipeline disruption) affecting core business operations.
operational.critical: Platform-wide outage, fleet/factory/BESS command-and-control lockout, or central IAM/K8s/ERP control plane compromise.
operational.catastrophic: Alias for critical: complete platform, factory MES, or fleet operations halt.

privacy.negligible: No PII, credentials, telemetry, or confidential customer data exposed.
privacy.low: Single-user non-sensitive profile metadata or anonymized technical identifier exposure.
privacy.medium: Single-user PII (name, phone, email, VIN) or limited historical telemetry exposed via authenticated BOLA.
privacy.high: Bulk multi-user PII/KYC documents, live GPS vehicle tracking, in-cabin camera/voice recordings, or proprietary AI training datasets.
privacy.critical: Mass exfiltration of national ID/KYC/financial records, fleet-wide live surveillance, or cryptographic identity/key material across tenants.
privacy.catastrophic: Alias for critical: population-scale PII/biometric/location or cryptographic key breach.

compliance.negligible: No regulatory, statutory, or contractual standard violation.
compliance.low: Minor internal policy deviation or low-severity audit log formatting gap.
compliance.medium: Single-control non-conformance under OWASP ASVS/MASVS or internal security baseline requiring remediation.
compliance.high: Reportable control failure under UNECE R155/R156 (CSMS/SUMS), ISO/SAE 21434, IEC 62443, or PCI-DSS.
compliance.critical: Statutory violation of Vietnam PDPD / Luật BVDLCN 91/2025, Luật ANM 116/2025 (cần Pháp chế/Compliance xác nhận số hiệu và hiệu lực hiện hành), GDPR, TT 05/2025/TT-BCT (cần Pháp chế/Compliance xác nhận số hiệu và hiệu lực hiện hành), or mandatory type-approval revocation.
compliance.catastrophic: Alias for critical: statutory breach triggering license/type-approval suspension or regulatory enforcement.
